label: expiry()
type: the sync-function helper that sets a document's TTL. Not an independent Sync-Gateway-only mechanism: it sets and is managed as the same underlying Couchbase Server document-expiration mechanism (data:expiration), down to the identical Unix-time-vs-interval-below-30-days convention. Not propagated on replication, and unsupported for databases in walrus (in-memory/test) mode.
note: The first relation in the sgw: namespace tying a sync-function helper directly to a promoted server/ concept rather than to another sgw:- or product-siloed idea.
